events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair began on this day in 1969, bringing together nearly half a million people for three days of peace and music.

angles.name: Woodstock Vibes
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, a field in Bethel, New York became the epicentre of a cultural revolution. What was your favourite Woodstock moment, or the track that defines the era for you?

events.title: Elvis Presley's Death Anniversary
events.blurb: The King of Rock & Roll, Elvis Presley, passed away on this day in 1977.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Remembering the undisputed King of Rock & Roll today. From his iconic voice to his unforgettable moves, Elvis left an indelible mark on music history.

events.title: Tupac Shakur Shooting Anniversary
events.blurb: Rapper Tupac Shakur was shot in Las Vegas on this day in 1996, and later died from his injuries on September 13.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: On this day in '96, a tragic event in Las Vegas shook the music world. Remembering the powerful legacy and enduring influence of Tupac Shakur.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Guitar legend Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970 at the age of 27.

angles.name: Guitar God Tribute
angles.copy: Fifty-six years since we lost one of music's most revolutionary guitarists. Jimi Hendrix's innovation and stage presence continue to inspire.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album in the UK on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Icon
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, The Beatles gave us the masterpiece that is 'Abbey Road'. That iconic cover, those unforgettable tracks… which one is on repeat for you?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer and founder of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the rock icon Chrissie Hynde! Her distinctive voice and fierce stage presence have given us decades of incredible music with The Pretenders.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the distinctive voice of Oasis and a successful solo artist, celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Happy 54th to the one and only Liam Gallagher! From Oasis anthems to his solo hits, his attitude and vocals are still pure rock 'n' roll.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Single Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless single 'Imagine' was first released in the US on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon released 'Imagine', a song that continues to resonate with its powerful message of peace and unity. Truly timeless.

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first generation iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? Twenty-five years ago, Apple dropped the first iPod, changing the game for music lovers everywhere. How many songs did yours hold?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', on this day in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred! It's James Bond Day, celebrating over six decades of 007. Who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, the iconic co-founder of The Beatles and celebrated solo artist, would have been 86 today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the visionary John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message of peace continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British comedy legend John Cleese, co-founder of Monty Python and star of Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the incredibly funny John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his unique brand of humour is truly timeless.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Masterpiece
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unveiled 'The White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece that showed every facet of their genius. What's your hidden gem from the tracklist?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering Freddie Mercury, the legendary frontman of Queen, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Forever
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since the world lost a true showman. Freddie Mercury's voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?
